title: Mexican Smoked Onion Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Mexican dish featuring smoky onions and a hint of melted cheese on skewers.

ingredients.name: Melted Cheese
ingredients.notes: Monterey Jack or Cheddar work well

instructions: 2. Cut the onion into large chunks and thread onto skewers.
3. Brush the onion with smoky seasoning.
4. Grill the skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the onion is tender and lightly charred.
5. Remove the skewers from the grill and top with melted cheese.
6. Return the skewers to the grill for an additional 30 seconds to 1 minute, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
